name: MFT Explorer
description: Browse an NTFS master file table as a directory tree and inspect the attributes behind each record.
about: MFT Explorer loads a $MFT and rebuilds the directory structure it describes, so a volume can be walked as folders and files rather than read as a table of records. Selecting an entry shows what the record actually holds: both the $STANDARD_INFORMATION and $FILE_NAME timestamp sets, the resident or non-resident data attributes, alternate data streams, and the parent reference the path was reconstructed from. Deleted entries still present in the table appear in place, which is what makes a file's former location visible. The reconstructed tree can be exported.
